title: Import Settings: Android system notification to allow file access not visible when requested on import, need to hit back to see it on previous screen
symptom: Upon a new installation of AndroidAPS, when importing backed up settings the first time, an Android system notification is needed to allow file access, but it is not visible on the 'Select file to import' screen. Only after pressing the back button does the notification appear on the previous screen, and then the import can proceed.
cause: The issue was a UX problem where the Android system notification for file access was not visible when requested during import; it only appeared after navigating back. The cause was not explicitly stated, but it was fixed by a commit.
fix: The issue was fixed by commit d1009e53218e90aac17639ff876b13467057ef4a. Additionally, a later comment noted that if the exported settings file is not named with a .json extension, AAPS may not recognize it; renaming the file to end in .json on the device resolves that.
